_comment: Driving power-ups (Drifting, Decisions, 'Driving power-ups', board 2026-10-31). The five are the board's (the fifth, the Polarized Steering Wheel: board 2026-11-02, Drifting, Decisions, 'Rusty Paintjob and the Polarized Steering Wheel'); every tier number is a proposal (Driving & Drift's call by the docs, written on its behalf by Game Data) for the board's playtest. Tier 1 is what the gift gives; tier 2 is the 'next tier' offer and the last. T-520 (Drifting, Decisions, 'Two tiers and three slots for the driving power-ups', board 2026-11-03, the 4-minute run): every power-up has 2 tiers, tier 2 equal to the old tier 4 (the old tiers 2 and 3 are gone). Distances in units (1 unit = the car's width), times in seconds.

offer_when_exhausted.reason: When every power-up is at its last tier there is nothing to offer: the gift is skipped (no overlay, no pause) and the run goes on. An overlay with no choices would only interrupt the run.

tiers.reason: Slow to charge, a short clear burst, so the first tier shows the idea.
Top tier: a big boost any time, still shorter than the hype boost chain.
A small hop: about 0.6 s in the air with the car's gravity, enough for the airtime missions.
Long enough for an air 360, jumping often.
Multiplies the T-435 wall bounce distance; 1.4 is felt but not wild.
Top tier: walls act like springs.

Half a minion's health (4, T-408); open questions for the board: the per-enemy repeat cooldown (0.5 s here, so driving through a crowd does not melt it each frame) and whether the kaiju is hit (not at tier 1).
Top tier also scrapes the kaiju (open question for the board).

+20% for half a second: felt as a kick, small enough that the lift-steer-gas move is a skill, not a must. Shared by every tier: W pressed again with the nose at least 60 degrees from where the car moves (the board's start), at most 1.2 s after letting go of W (long enough to swing the nose round 180 degrees at the turn rate, short enough to read as one move; S held during the coast cancels it), on the ground, the car moving at least 2 units/s (a stopped car has no direction); the burst holds the forward speed at least at the multiplier x the speed carried into the press (cruise speed at the least) for 0.5 s; no cooldown.

+45% (only a little more: the shock is this tier's prize) and Bricks' tier 1 wave at the car on every burst (shock_bricks_tier 1: radius 4, damage 6, minions pushed 4, the kaiju damaged and never pushed, read from weapons.json so it follows Bricks), owned or not.
